content: Our agent evolution paper RSIHub was accepted to the First Workshop on Meta Agents: Managing Agents that Manage Agents (NeurIPS 2026)!
We built PoliCon to test whether LLMs can draft resolutions that win cross-party support. The paper was accepted to ICLR 2026.
TMLR accepted The AI Hippocampus, our survey of how language models and agents store and use memories.
Our paper on UAPO shows how to learn from unpaired preference data. It was accepted to EMNLP 2025!
Our ReflectEvo paper on how small language models learn from their own reflections was accepted to ACL 2025.
ICLR 2025 accepted ICE, our method for helping language models retain new facts after the context is removed.
